About the app.

The initial product focuses on ages 4–5, with the child experience on Apple Watch and a parent experience on iPhone. A public App Store release, launch date and subscription pricing have not been announced on this website.

Before buying a device: the current beta uses a Watch normally paired with an iPhone. Apple Family Setup onboarding is not supported in that beta. Please confirm release compatibility before purchasing hardware for TrustinJr.

The app is not positioned as a school-time device. Follow your school’s device policies. Audio-first also does not mean screen-free: the app includes pictures, reading text and touch interactions.

Interested in what comes next?

Parents can email the project to ask about availability or share feedback. Please keep messages about your interests and device questions; no personal information about a child is needed.
